objective: Find a custom optimization that is valid and faster than native HF and V11 Triton under the original full8B gates.
rule: Audit each method with its same-order qualified nativeHF and V11 controls. A rejected auxiliary HF-custom port cannot support speed claims and does not certify or invalidate another method. Every recommended Triton method must independently pass all399 gradient checks, full validation, unchanged quality/memory/CUDA gates and >=3% lower complete step time vs both controls in both orders.
